deliveryChannel.label: Where to send removal explanations
deliveryChannel.helpText: An in-place comment on the item, a modmail to the author (the appeal channel), or both.

appealsEnabled.label: Include an appeal path
appealsEnabled.helpText: Adds a 'reply here if you think this is a mistake' line. Appeals go to a human moderator; the bot never overturns removals.

appealInstructions.label: Appeal instructions
appealInstructions.defaultValue: If you think this was a mistake, reply to this message and a moderator will review it. (This is an automated notice; a human makes the final call.)

messageTemplate.label: Explanation template

perReasonOptOut.label: Do NOT notify for these reasons (comma-separated)
perReasonOptOut.helpText: E.g. spam, ban evasion — reasons where tipping off the author is undesirable.

automodFilterDailyCap.label: Daily AutoMod-filter explanations per author (0 = unlimited)
automodFilterDailyCap.helpText: Hard ceiling on how many times Receipts will explain AutoMod silent-filter removals to the same author per UTC day. Protects against turning the silent filter into a spammer feedback channel. Per-author, per-subreddit.
